title: subagent fails and feedback to gemini is really low quality

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides specific reproduction details, client/environment information, and an exact error trace showing that when a subagent fails due to an API or tool error (400 INVALID_ARGUMENT), raw unformatted API JSON error objects are returned directly to the main Gemini model as low-quality error feedback.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Addressing this issue requires updating subagent error handling and error prompt formatting across multiple subagent invocation modules (local-invocation.ts, local-session-invocation.ts, local-executor.ts, agent-tool.ts) in packages/core to sanitize raw API error payloads and construct structured, actionable feedback for the main model, along with adding unit tests in local-invocation.test.ts.

summary.problem: Subagent failures caused by API or tool execution errors return raw, stringified JSON error payloads directly to the parent model in llmContent, resulting in low-quality error feedback that lacks actionable guidance.
summary.root_cause: In LocalSubagentInvocation and LocalSessionInvocation, uncaught subagent execution errors are formatted simply as 'Subagent <name> failed. Error: <errorMessage>', which forwards raw API response payloads without sanitization or structured recovery guidance for the main agent.
summary.context: When a subagent encounters an API validation error (e.g. 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT during model calls or tool calls), the subagent execution loop fails and returns raw error details back to the parent Gemini session.

steps: Sanitize and format subagent execution error messages in local-invocation.ts and local-session-invocation.ts to extract human-readable error descriptions instead of raw stringified API JSON objects.
Enhance the llmContent error message returned to the main agent upon subagent failure to include structured context, clear action items, and actionable recovery guidance rather than raw error text.

Improve error catching and handling inside local-executor.ts during subagent tool call execution and model turn handling to prevent unhandled API errors from causing sudden subagent crashes where graceful recovery is possible.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a subagent encounters an API or tool call error, the error feedback returned in llmContent to the parent model is clean, human-readable, and provides actionable guidance without dumping raw JSON API error objects.
verification_steps: Add a test case in local-invocation.test.ts simulating a subagent failure with a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT API error.
Verify that llmContent returned by the invocation contains a formatted, actionable error message rather than raw stringified JSON error objects.
